subfiles.about: Despatch transmitting a copy of SCAP directive SCAPIN-824 regarding the confiscation of wartime Japanese propaganda publications and forwarding collected copies to Washington.
subfiles.from: United States Political Adviser for Japan
subfiles.summary: Despatch No. 420 forwards SCAPIN-824 on seizing ten propaganda titles and sends copies of each by sea pouch.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 420 from US Political Adviser for Japan on Confiscated Japanese Propaganda Publications

subfiles.about: SCAP directive ordering the Japanese Government to collect, centrally store, and report on ten specific wartime propaganda publications pending pulping.
subfiles.from: Brigadier General B. M. Fitch, Adjutant General (for the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers)
subfiles.summary: SCAPIN-824 orders bulk stocks of ten wartime propaganda titles, including works by Arita and Amau, seized and pulped, exempting private copies.
